_comment: Troll (intermission triage Session ②, item 20): a solitary bruiser squatting at the map outskirts, a difficulty tier BETWEEN the bandits (cL5-7) and the orc front (cL20) — curveLevel 11, elite. Very tanky, very slow, hits hard but rarely (TrollSmash). Spawns alone or in pairs. Drops Tough, repairing the Barrier recipe (Hardy + Tough). Own portrait sprite (EntityType Troll). All values [PLACEHOLDER] ⚑ NUMBERS REWRITE C2d (D4): partial resistances. Before this pass resistances existed ONLY as lock-and-key gates ({"*": 0, "harvest": 1}) — never as mitigation — so every hit in the game landed for full and a damage type meant nothing. These are the curated set that gives the type axis teeth: the classic: it shrugs off wounds and it fears fire. Deliberately NON-physical — the C8 tier-threshold guardrail drives its bot with authored Damage at L1, which is physical, so a physical entry here would silently move a calibration this pass has no business moving. All values [PLACEHOLDER].
